svg.text: Every server builds 64-bit, time-sortable IDs locally — no coordination needed

g.text: A service asks its local generator for a new ID
Take the current millisecond timestamp (41 bits ≈ 69 years)
Add datacenter + machine IDs (fixed at startup)
Add a sequence number that resets every millisecond
Concatenate the bits → a unique, roughly time-ordered 64-bit ID
Returned instantly — no database or coordinator involved
